The '''Mugaari pirates''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They operated in the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], and terrorized the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by allying themselves with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were defeated by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
